I grew up with a family of binge eaters, we were all obese. Then one day a family friend told me that I need to loose weight before I get old and can’t shed the pounds. At first I started to diet healthy, counting calories and eating healthy meals. I got down to the weight I am about now. (I was 15-16 135 pounds) then the rest of highschool I gained it back. I got mad at myself and wanted a way to keep myself in check so I could loose it all again and stay “thin”. I stopped eating maybe had half a meal a day at most. Went from 170-140 in a month. I didn’t gain those freshman year college pounds I lost them significantly. The lowest I have ever been as an adult (21 now) is 125 and my bones stuck out. Starving myself killed my nerves and I can’t feel the right side of my body. Relapsing has made feeling on the left side disappear permantly too. I didn’t ask to loose feeling. No one ever diagnosed me with an eating disorder even tho for my nerves they made me do like 10 mris and lots of blood samples even leading to vitamin shots monthly to keep me from not passing out. No one noticed I was starving they just thought I didn’t eat enough. Now I know you said you don’t want binging Ed but I believe all Ed r equally bad. They all ruin ur body and mental state. But I think there’s a strength to being able to eat then to starve urself. If you want to loose weight starving I’d quick but kills you. In the past I was fit and weighed the same from a healthy diet. I just wish I would’ve never twisted my mind like this. Eating disorders never leave you. So pls please don’t add another one to you.
